messages:
Michelle: Heads-up — seeing elevated webhook delivery errors for a subset of onboarders starting ~03:10 UTC. Customers report intermittent 502s from our callback endpoint. Opening thread for CS outreach and quick mitigation notes.
Arjun: Investigating now. Initial glance shows ingress LB returning 502s upstream timeout, correlated with a retry spike from partner integrations. Pulling traces and request rates.
Jamal: Root cause sketch: partner retry storm caused route-service queues to spike; KV cache evictions slowed processing and exposed an upstream timeout config that defaulted to 60s. Pushing temporary config change to prevent tail latency.
ops-bot: deploy infra/ingress-timeout-patch started -> canary -> prod (3/3) :white_check_mark:
Arjun: Patch applied to prod at 03:22 UTC. 502 rate down ~90% vs peak. Still draining backlog, monitoring headroom.
Michelle: Drafting customer note for affected tenants — please review and flag changes. Short, empathetic, action-focused. Draft below:
Michelle: "Hi <Customer>, we detected delays in webhook delivery between 03:10–03:22 UTC which caused intermittent 502s for callbacks. We've mitigated the issue: lowered ingress upstream timeout, increased route worker capacity, and added immediate backpressure to reduce retries. Full delivery completion expected within 60 minutes. We're preparing an RCA and offering a credit for the affected window plus a 30-min enablement review of webhook best practices. Will follow with individualized details. — Michelle (CS)"
Elaine: wording looks good. Recommend offering 20% credit for high-touch/renewal-risk accounts and keep 10% for self-serve. I'll pull the affected account list and segment urgency.
Michelle: Good call. @Elaine can you send segmented list and the individualized note templates? I'll send the bulk notice to low-touch accounts now.
Jamal: RCA (short): queue overload at route-service v2.0 due to partner client retry loops and missing per-tenant circuit-breaker. Fixes deployed: 1) ingress timeout reduced from 60s -> 10s, 2) worker_pool scaled +50% temporarily, 3) per-tenant circuit-breaker & rate-limit added to route-service, 4) logging/observability for retry patterns. Full postmortem will include timeline, root cause, and follow-ups.
Michelle: Approved. I'll send the customer comms and add a link to the follow-up RCA when ready. Sending to ~17 affected tenants now.
Arjun: Monitoring dashboard: error % is ~2% now (down from 22% at peak). Delivery throughput back to baseline for 98% of requests after 12 minutes post-patch. Keeping a 2-hour watch window.
Elaine: I'll schedule enablement sessions starting tomorrow, and prepare a short playbook for partners on exponential backoff + idempotency keys. Will attach sample headers and retry guidance.
Jamal: For the postmortem I'll include the log snippet and the remedial config diff. Quick log sample below for ops playbook:
Jamal: ```
[03:11:02] route-service v2 WARN queue_length=1240 retries=310 source=partner-x
[03:15:48] ingress ERROR upstream_timeout tenant=acct-1234 request_id=abcd-ef01
[03:22:06] infra INFO patch_applied ingress_timeout=10s
```
Michelle: Thanks all. After customer comms I'll post an exec summary to #cs-incident-communications and attach the RCA draft. :thumbsup:
Arjun: Will keep alerts on and notify if any regression.
ops-bot: incident-tracker updated: incident_id=INC-2023-2308765432 status=mitigated assigned=[Arjun,Jamal]
Elaine: Reporting: I'll include renewal-risk flagging for the top 5 affected accounts and propose 20% credit + a dedicated enablement call. Sending seg list in 15m.
Michelle: Closing thread for now — reopening if errors spike. Thanks team.
